# Data directory

Nothing here is committed. Everything is either downloadable or derived.

## Required before a real run

**`lm_dictionary.csv`** — the Loughran-McDonald Master Dictionary, free from the
Notre Dame Software Repository for Accounting and Finance. Not vendored here
because of its licence terms.

Without it the pipeline falls back to small seed word lists and prints a warning
on every run. Those seeds are for testing only — do not report a result produced
with them.

## Generated by scripts/01_ingest.py

- `transcripts.jsonl` — normalised transcripts
- `panel.parquet` — firm-quarter panel with returns and controls
- `factors.csv` — Fama-French factors from the Ken French Data Library

## Licence note

The Hugging Face transcript dataset is community-uploaded and probably scraped.
Check the dataset card before publishing. If the licence is unclear, publish
derived per-firm-quarter features rather than raw text.
